name: Sar Li Ram
tagline: I build scalable web applications with React, Next.js, Node.js and AWS — from the interface to the server.
about: I'm a full stack developer who loves working with JavaScript across the whole stack — building interfaces in React and Next.js, APIs in Node.js, and the servers and cloud setups that run them.

I've built and deployed products on AWS (Amplify, Lambda, RDS) and on DigitalOcean with Docker and Nginx, across point-of-sale, real estate and e-commerce. I care about efficient, robust solutions and enjoy leaning on open-source tools to move fast.
